title: Bass method and studying the hard way
summary: He describes starting on a four-string bass and studying with Marrero's method book, with little other teaching.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: And when you started, did you have a three string bass or four?

No. No. But I could play three strings. I started with four. Simon Morrill was one. That's the first thing he told me, he said, you've got to play the right type of bass. You've got to learn to play the E strings. They're all played. He just wanted to think, it's note on all strings. So I started because, I'll tell you why, he had a bass method. That's why, you hear this man say, I used to pack my book around all the time. I had to pack the book to watch the notes. I was very serious about this, and the positions, and the different T's, and everything. I was studying hard, the hard way, you know, because I didn't have very much teaching right then and there, you know. So, but then I started playing around like the rest of the guys.
